text_block_list.text:
Two other Umamusume debut several
months
after Нарита Таисин.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As both friends and worthy rivals, Narita
Taishin
believes in them, and the three
all have their
sights set on the Classic
Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин's determined not to lose
and
throws herself into training to
prepare for the
inevitable battles against
her companions.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
